"""Verify exact publication,sources,all rounded cells and every native panel pixel."""
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from demosaic.late_nonlocal_residual import LateNonlocalResidualDetail
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V171-matching-residual-v1'
output=repo/'docs/results/v171-matching-residual-publication-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
index=repo/'docs/results/v171-matching-residual-final-v1.json';final=read(index);plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
for k in ['preparation','CPU_readiness','postprocess_preparation','runtime_dependency_preparation','preparer_dependency_fix','postprocess_dependency_correction','sources','figures','report']:assert ref(final[k]['path'])==final[k]
for copies in final['copies'].values():
 for b in copies.values():assert ref(b['path'])==b
 assert Path(copies['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copies['public']['path']).read_bytes()
prep=read(final['preparation']['path']);sources=read(final['sources']['path']);source_checks=0
for source in prep['source_texts']+sources['additional_sources']:
 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text'];source_checks+=1
for name,h in plan['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==h
assert len(plan['prior_neural_hashes'])==93
runtime_fix=read(final['runtime_dependency_preparation']['path']);future_fix=read(final['preparer_dependency_fix']['path']);post_fix=read(final['postprocess_dependency_correction']['path'])
for source in [runtime_fix['new_dependency'],runtime_fix['source'],future_fix['current_runner']]+post_fix['source_texts']:
 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text'];source_checks+=1
assert runtime_fix['all_original_frozen_files_unchanged'] and runtime_fix['new_scientific_forwards_before_relaunch']==0
assert set(future_fix['unchanged_functions'])=={'resources','runtime','make_module','tree_equal','train','review','launch'}

for endpoint,binding in final['checkpoints'].items():
 assert ref(binding['export']['path'])==binding['export'];state=torch.load(binding['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 module=LateNonlocalResidualDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True)
 assert model_hash(module)==binding['module_hash'] and model_hash(module.frozen)==binding['frozen_module_hash']
 assert len(module.state_dict())==188 and len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters())==2088906
 assert state['frozen_component']==plan['frozen_component'] and ref(state['source']['path'])==state['source']
paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summary={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v1.json');report=repo/'docs/learned-matching-residual.md';text=report.read_text();assert ref(report)==bindings['report']==final['report']
for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==60 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==12
prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);old_map={i['image']['path']:i for i in prior['images']};new_channels=copied_channels=0
for item in native['images']:
 old=old_map[item['source_figure']['path']]
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 for field in ['ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure']:assert item[field]==old[field]
 image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));old_image=np.asarray(Image.open(old['image']['path']));a=dict(np.load(item['case']['arrays']['path']));anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1);old_panels={p['label']:p for p in old['panels']}
 for panel in item['panels']:
  name=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if name in item['predictions']:
   b=item['predictions'][name];assert ref(b['path'])==b;value=np.load(b['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   label={'V169 EMA':'balanced-EMA'}.get(name,name);p=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=p['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)
view=read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json');assert view['native_figures']==60 and sorted(view['indices'])==list(range(60)) and ref(view['journal']['path'])==view['journal']
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');assert execution['quality_wrapper_calls']==1644 and execution['repeated_scientific_prefix_calls']==0
training=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json');assert training['cached_batches_checked']==1000 and training['final_Adam_states']==141
quality=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json');assert quality['input_fingerprints_checked']==6576 and quality['saved_native_RGB_checked']==quality['saved_native_residuals_checked']==72 and quality['ADC_outputs_exact_V169']==144
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
documents=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/learned-matching-residual.md']]+[diary]
links=0
for p in documents:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  resolved=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert resolved==output or resolved.is_file(),(p,target);links+=1
save(output,dict(status='pass-exact-copies-sources-endpoints-tables-native-pixels-and-links',publication=ref(index),exact_copies=len(final['copies']),source_texts_checked=source_checks,unchanged_prior_neural_files=93,strict_full_state_endpoint_loads=2,rounded_table_cells=len(bindings['cells']),native_figures=60,native_triplets=12,new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,document_links_checked=links,documents={str(p):ref(p) for p in documents},new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope=quality['scope']))
print('PASS',len(final['copies']),'exact copies;',source_checks,'source texts;',len(bindings['cells']),'cells;60 native figures;',new_channels+copied_channels,'RGB channels;',links,'links')
